text: Day fourteen. (beat) And this is where it gets strange. That same study tested people's focus. One boring task. Stay on it. Don't drift. After two weeks without mobile internet, their focus improved... as much as being about ten years younger. Ten years. No pill. No app. Just... less scrolling. {neutral} Nine out of ten people got better at something. Their mood, their focus, or how they felt about life.
